entries.title: Job 18:1
segments: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

entries.title: Job 18:2
segments: How long will ye hunt for words? Consider, and afterwards we will speak.

entries.title: Job 18:3
segments: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, [And] are become unclean in your sight?

entries.title: Job 18:4
segments: Thou that tearest thyself in thine anger, Shall the earth be forsaken for thee? Or shall the rock be removed out of its place?

entries.title: Job 18:5
segments: Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, And the spark of his fire shall not shine.

entries.title: Job 18:6
segments: The light shall be dark in his tent, And his lamp above him shall be put out.

entries.title: Job 18:7
segments: The steps of his strength shall be straitened, And his own counsel shall cast him down.

entries.title: Job 18:8
segments: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, And he walketh upon the toils.

entries.title: Job 18:9
segments: A gin shall take [him] by the heel, [And] a snare shall lay hold on him.

entries.title: Job 18:10
segments: A noose is hid for him in the ground, And a trap for him in the way.

entries.title: Job 18:11
segments: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, And shall chase him at his heels.

entries.title: Job 18:12
segments: His strength shall be hunger-bitten, And calamity shall be ready at his side.

entries.title: Job 18:13
segments: The members of his body shall be devoured, [Yea], the first-born of death shall devour his members.

entries.title: Job 18:14
segments: He shall be rooted out of his tent where he trusteth; And he shall be brought to the king of terrors.

entries.title: Job 18:15
segments: There shall dwell in his tent that which is none of his: Brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.

entries.title: Job 18:16
segments: His roots shall be dried up beneath, And above shall his branch be cut off.

entries.title: Job 18:17
segments: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, And he shall have no name in the street.

entries.title: Job 18:18
segments: He shall be driven from light into darkness, And chased out of the world.

entries.title: Job 18:19
segments: He shall have neither son nor son's son among his people, Nor any remaining where he sojourned.

entries.title: Job 18:20
segments: They that come after shall be astonished at his day, As they that went before were affrighted.

entries.title: Job 18:21
segments: Surely such are the dwellings of the unrighteous, And this is the place of him that knoweth not God.
